home.title: Home
home.subtitle: The instance you have selected, ready to launch.
home.emptyBody: Own mods, configs, packs, worlds. Vanilla, Fabric, Quilt, Forge, NeoForge.
home.signedOut: Add an account for online, or an offline profile for singleplayer.
home.signedIn: Signed in as {{user}}. Pick an instance, or host a world for friends.
home.hostNote: LAN hosting for this instance stays here. The global directory lives on Host.

library.title: Library
library.subtitle: Installed instances — select one, then play it from Home.

browse.title: Browse
browse.subtitle: Modpacks from Modrinth and CurseForge. A pack becomes its own instance; single mods install into the one you pick.
browse.packOwnInstance: Packs install with their own game version.
browse.emptyHint: Type a name, or browse popular.
browse.toastNoInstanceBody: Make an instance first, then install mods.

host.title: Host
host.subtitle: Share a world — P2P, LAN, or a join code.
host.soonBody: Global P2P is paused in this build. LAN worlds and join codes still work.
host.paused: P2P is paused · the screen stays live

profile.title: Profile
profile.subtitle: Skin, account, and cape.
profile.emptyBody: Sign in with Microsoft, Ely.by, or sx.acc for skins and capes, or create an offline profile.
profile.uploadMicrosoft: Goes straight to Mojang on your Minecraft session.
profile.uploadEly: Upload is on Ely.by. We check the PNG, then send you there.
profile.uploadOffline: Offline profiles can’t upload a skin.
profile.uploadSxacc: When the server accepts it, the PNG goes to sx.acc. Otherwise the check stays local.
profile.authlibNote: Ely.by skins hitch to the JVM via Authlib so other Ely.by players see them. Changed it? Hit “Reload skin”.
profile.authlibSxacc: sx.acc sessions launch with authlib pointed at your server. The skin shows here when the account API returns one.
profile.offlineFallback: Offline shows the default avatar — no login, no skin to fetch.
profile.uploadDrop: You can also drop a PNG on this page.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Stored on this device. Only the server directory URL uses the network.
settings.languageHint: The launcher opens in Turkish. Switch any time — chrome updates immediately.
settings.themeHint: Charcoal is the default. The accent still tints buttons, the active rail, and focus rings on every preset.
settings.accentHint: Galactic purple is the default. A custom color paints the same CSS variables live.
settings.sxaccBaseHint: Sign-in is {BASE}/v1/auth/login, registration is {BASE}/v1/auth/register, authlib is {BASE}/authlib/. Public server: https://sx-acc.vercel.app. Leave empty to disable. SXACC_BASE_URL overrides this field.

login.title: Sign in
login.body: Microsoft, Ely.by, and sx.acc can open in your browser. Offline profiles stay on this device. Secrets stay in the OS vault.
login.microsoftBody: Opens the Minecraft sign-in page in your browser, then returns here. Needed for online play.
login.waiting: Waiting for the browser to finish. You can close that tab once sign-in completes.
login.elyBody: Ely.by skins and capes. We wire Authlib into the JVM.
login.elyBrowser: Sign in with Ely.by in the browser
login.offlineBody: A local profile for singleplayer and LAN. The same nickname always maps to the same player.
login.sxaccBody: sx.acc uses your in-game name and password. Sign-in sends that username (16 characters max), not an email. The game launches with authlib pointed at that server.
login.sxaccMissing: Set the sx.acc base URL in Settings → Accounts first. SXMLAUNCHER does not assume a host.
login.sxaccRegisterHint: Registration happens on your sx.acc server, from this launcher.
login.device: Can't open a browser? Use a device code

activity.title: Activity
activity.subtitle: Downloads, launches, and hosting. A healthy world does not show a progress bar.
activity.emptyBody: Installs, packs, assets, and Java downloads land here, with a stop button that really stops them.

presence.settingsBody: Shows what this launcher is doing on Discord. Leave the application id empty to turn it off. If Discord is not running, nothing happens.
presence.appIdHint: Digits from the Discord Developer Portal. SXML_DISCORD_APPLICATION_ID overrides this. Upload a logo as Rich Presence art with the key sxmlauncher.

errors.relogin: Sign in again. This session expired.
errors.sxaccOffline: sx.acc is unreachable. Check the connection, then try again.
errors.sxaccRefresh: sx.acc did not finish refreshing this session. Sign in again to keep playing. Your saved login was kept.
errors.skinAppliedBody: Uploaded. The game picks it up on the next launch.
